text.p: These are the leading stories in the Algerian press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Civilians targeted by Islamist armed groups: two bombs explode in Algiers killing 10 people and wounding more than 60.
- Campaigning for the Thursday parliamentary election ending on Monday.
- Poll campaign stained by bloodshed: two bombs ripped through two passenger buses killing seven people and wounding dozens.
- Candidates continue campaigning for the election.

- Abdelkader Bensalah, leader of National Democratic Rally which groups backers of President Liamine Zeroual, told a campaign rally in the eastern town of Batna his party wants to spread hope to rebuild the country.
- Army and security forces vote on Monday in parliamentary election ahead of Thursday's national polling.
- Passenger buses' bombing toll has risen to 11 dead, according to hospital sources.
- President Zeroual takes part in Organisation of African Unity meeting in Harare, Zimbabwe.
